metric_definitions.success: all required task conditions, verification and report delivery must finish within the action budget
metric_definitions.total_errors: actions returning failure, including injected faults; valid but unproductive repeated actions are not counted here
metric_definitions.mean_steps: all assigned tasks, including failures that use the full budget
metric_definitions.recovery_rate: completed recoveries divided by all assigned read/write fault cases, including cases where the policy never reached the fault

limitations: known task/tool/fault families; new numerical grids and held-out introductory wording only; not unseen task compositions
single training seed; 8 development regression probes plus 20 new held-out probes, not comprehensive general-capability evidence
same state/update cap; measured compute differs; no universal superiority claim
D runs first and bears cold-prefix cache cost; E reuses cache. Timings include concurrent engineering checks and are not a controlled speed benchmark.
